description: This pie chart visually compares two components of total time cost: “Reduction” at 69.92% (represented by a large orange slice) and “Efficient deployment” at 30.08% (represented by a smaller blue slice). The chart is divided into two segments, with the “Reduction” slice occupying the majority of the circle and the “Efficient deployment” slice occupying the remainder. Both segments are labeled with their respective names and percentages, and the “Efficient deployment” slice is slightly separated from the rest of the pie, appearing exploded. The chart does not include a legend, and the percentages are explicitly labeled within each slice.
